title: BUG: [Repeat] same mode twice on one target (820.2.a): 4 + 4 kills an 8-Might base unit

repro.testName: BUG: [Repeat] same mode twice on one target (820.2.a): 4 + 4 kills an 8-Might base unit

history.note: Root-caused + verified green, but unlandable this iteration: pending-choice.ts carries two other lanes' uncommitted WIP (spell-modes play-time mode picks; getNotHandSelfEnergyReduction) so land-patch would commit their half-done work. FIX: liftModalTarget() must copy thenIsSequenceRest onto the choose-target prompt it raises, and the choose-target branch must run a carried thenIsSequenceRest continuation with boundTargets STRIPPED (rule 820.2.a — later Repeat executions must not inherit the target just picked; today they re-hit it, so 'kill a gear' twice kills only the first). Full engine suite green with that change.
